item.title: New Mauna Kea Authority Has Difficult Task Ahead — And Limited Time
item.description: University officials and some senators are concerned about the fate of astronomy on the mountain.

item.title: Word Row: Feb. 17
item.description: One word. Five letters. Six chances to solve. You can do it.

item.title: Divers Are Dying Near The Surface. Now There’s A Call For Safety Warnings
item.description: Freediving is one of the leading causes of fatal drownings for Hawaiʻi residents. Now lawmakers and safety advocates want labels on equipment — and more.

item.title: Will Bailey: Our Fragile State Is Too Dependent On The Kindness Of Billionaires
item.description: If large-scale ownership is now part of Hawaiʻi’s future, then large-scale stewardship must be as well.

item.title: Hawaiʻi County Inspectors Missed Illegal Rentals In Factory That Burned
item.description: The county subsidized rentals in an office building 30 feet away on the same property, but overlooked illegal units in the adjacent poi factory.

item.title: Hawaiʻi Was Once A National Leader In Long-Term Care Financing
item.description: We are now playing catchup, but proposed bills at the Legislature show we can chart our destiny once more.

item.title: Word Search: US Presidents
item.description: In honor of President's Day, you can find a bunch of them in this game.

item.title: Is Haleakalā The Next Frontier For A Telescope Standoff?
item.description: Plans for several new military telescopes atop the mountain are drawing strong opposition. But protests over other Maui telescope projects in recent years have failed to have the same impact as the anti-TMT movement on the Big Island.

item.title: The Sunshine Blog: If The Iceman Commeth, He Better Drop That Mask
item.description: Short takes, outtakes, our takes and other stuff you should know about public information, government accountability and ethical leadership in Hawai‘i.

item.title: Fatal HPD Shooting: No Charges For Cops Who Shot Barricaded Man
item.description: Honolulu Prosecutor Steve Alm said officers did not know the gun that Eric Walsh pointed at them was a replica that didn't fire bullets.
